The '''Jiguuna Market''' was an open-air marketplace in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Jiguuna]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was located just outside of [[Nem'ro's Palace]].<ref name="TOR" />
